item.title: A Delhi-based tattoo artist found dead with injuries in Akola
item.description: In Akola, tragedy struck as a 26-year-old tattoo artist from Delhi, Shantikriya Kashyap, was discovered dead early Wednesday in Murtizapur. She had sustained multiple head injuries, likely caused by a sharp weapon. Authorities suspect her live-in partner, Kunal alias Sunny Shringare, who is currently evading capture.
